title: SQL injection via f-string query formatting
diff:
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 def get_user_by_username(db_session, username: str):
     if not username:
         return None
-    query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = :name"
-    return db_session.execute(query, {"name": username}).first()
+    query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '{username}'"
+    return db_session.execute(query).first()

ground_truth.description: Direct f-string formatting of untrusted parameter into SQL query causes SQL injection vulnerability.
